357394.title: Reversal invariance conjecture for the Thue–Morse sequence in base $3/2$

This is one of the conjectured structural symmetries of the sequence; the source provides no resolution.

\alpha(G) \geq 1+\frac{c(G)}{2}
$$

359547.title: Renner–Wolf conjecture on reduced intrinsic information and secret-key rate
359547.literal_statement:
Let $P_{XYZ}$ be a probability distribution. The **Renner–Wolf conjecture.**

$$
S(X:Y||Z)=I(X:Y \downarrow \downarrow Z).
$$

The reduced intrinsic information is a known upper bound on the secret-key rate and can be strictly smaller than the intrinsic information. Equality would give a simple distribution-based characterization of the secret-key rate; the paper presents this as an open problem.

362481.title: The path extremal conjecture for the game cordiality number of trees
362481.literal_statement:

$$
c_g(T)\le c_g(P_n).
$$
 This conjecture proposes that paths are the worst-case trees for the cordiality game, in contrast to the upper bound proved earlier in the paper. Its status is not specified in the source.

364842.title: The conjectured strict exclusion bounds for the cube-approximation function
364842.literal_statement:
Let $g$ be the function defined in Theorem, and let $k$ and $i$ be the parameters occurring there. **Strict exclusion conjecture.** One has

$$
g\neq L\quad\text{if }i\leq k-1,
$$

and

$$
g\neq W\quad\text{if }i\geq k+1.
$$

The paper presents this as a stronger result than the bounds proved immediately beforehand; no proof or resolution is given in the supplied text.

364981.title: Interval colorability of planar Cartesian products
364981.literal_statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be non-trivial graphs, and suppose that their Cartesian product $G\square H$ is planar. **Planar Cartesian product conjecture.** The graph $G\square H$ is interval colorable. This would extend known results for planar Cartesian products and provide a broader interval-colorability theorem beyond the previously established cases.

365131.title: Šámal's normal chromatic-index conjecture
365131.literal_statement:
Let $G$ be a bridgeless cubic graph, and let $\chi'_{N}(G)$ be its normal chromatic index. **Šámal's conjecture.** Every bridgeless cubic graph $G$ satisfies

$$
\chi'_{N}(G)\leq 6.
$$

This is presented as an intermediate goal toward the stronger normal chromatic-index bound $\chi'_{N}(G)\leq 5$ and remains open.

365686.title: The planar cycle-isolation partition conjecture
365686.literal_statement: A **cycle isolating set** of a graph is a vertex set whose closed neighborhood leaves no cycle. **The planar cycle-isolation partition conjecture.** Every connected planar graph, except $C_3$, can be partitioned into four disjoint cycle isolating sets. This is proposed as a planar version of the preceding cycle-isolation partition conjecture; the paper gives no resolution.

366009.title: Nonnegativity conjecture for the matroid polynomial g-invariant
366009.literal_statement: Let $M$ be a matroid, and let $g_M(t)\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ be the covaluative matroid invariant described in the paper. **Nonnegativity conjecture for $g_M(t)$.** For any matroid $M$, the coefficients of $g_M(t)$ are nonnegative. This conjecture would imply the f-vector conjecture for matroidal decompositions of uniform matroids; its resolution is not established in the supplied text.

371432.title: The conjectured leading constant for the induced saturation number of the butterfly poset
371432.literal_statement:
Let $\mathcal N$ denote the poset considered in the paper, and let $\operatorname{sat}^*(n,\mathcal N)$ be its induced saturation number. **Conjecture on $\mathcal N$.**

$$
\operatorname{sat}^*(n,\mathcal N)=2n.
$$

The authors state that their proof establishes linearity but does not give the optimal constant, motivating this conjecture. The supplied text gives no resolution.

371532.title: Ferroni–Schröter's real-rootedness conjecture for Chow polynomials
371532.literal_statement: Let $\mathrm{M}$ be a matroid, and let its Chow polynomial be the polynomial invariant associated with its lattice of flats. **Ferroni–Schröter's conjecture.** The Chow polynomial of $\mathrm{M}$ has only nonpositive real roots. This is a central real-rootedness question for matroid invariants; the source presents it as a motivating conjecture, without stating a resolution.

371532.ordinary_attempt_and_gap_or_explicit_exc: Berczi, Coron, Eur, Li publicly refute this exact assertion on 12 October 2026. Theorem C gives simple 3-connected rank-seven matroids Tr^7(M_q directsum M_q directsum U_1,1) whose ordinary Chow polynomial is not real-rooted for odd prime powers q>=47. Choose prime47. This directly negates all-matroid real-rootedness, with no inference from failures of a stronger property. Theorem B plus Theorem A and Corollary D supplies a separate non-log-concavity amplification route; nonnegative real-rooted polynomials are log-concave by Newton. Proof bodies describe flag counts and discriminant thresholds; this lane did not rerun those computations or audit every construction lemma.
